sso.title: Microsoft Entra single sign-on
sso.description: Let people sign in with their Microsoft work account.
sso.enabledHint: Shows a “Sign in with Microsoft” button on the sign-in page.
sso.redirectHint: Add this as a Web redirect URI in the app registration.
sso.groupsHint: Entra group object IDs. A user gets the highest role of the groups they are in; users in none of them are refused.
sso.allowLocalHint: When off, only local administrators can still use a password (emergency access).
sso.howTo: Setup in Entra: create an app registration, add the redirect URI below, create a client secret, and under Token configuration add the “groups” claim (security groups) to the ID token.

errors.missing_group_mapping: Map at least one Entra group to a role before enabling single sign-on.
errors.missing_fields: Fill in the tenant ID, client ID and client secret before enabling single sign-on.

mail.oauthHint: Uses the client credentials flow. The app registration needs the SMTP.SendAsApp permission and the mailbox must allow SMTP AUTH.
